items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 18 at 6:29AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Total snow accumulations of up to 2 to 4 inches expected
with rain mixing in with snow at times. Winds gusting as high
as 30 mph.

* WHERE...Eastern Norton Sound, Nulato Hills, Yukon Delta Coast,
Lower Yukon Valley, and Innoko Valley.

* WHEN...From Sunday afternoon through Monday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Snow could be heavy at
times. Areas of blowing snow could significantly reduce
visibility.
items.areas: Eastern Norton Sound and Nulato Hills; Yukon Delta Coast; Lower Yukon River; Lower Yukon and Innoko Valleys
items.instruction: Slow down and use caution while traveling.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued October 18 at 6:16AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Total snow accumulations of up to 3 to 6 inches expected
at Kivalina, Noatak, and Red Dog Dock, with over 6 inches
possible at Red Dog Mine. Winds gusting as high as 30 mph. Rain
could mix with snow along the coast.

* WHERE...Noatak Valley, Kivalina, Red Dog Dock, and Red Dog Mine.

* WHEN...From Sunday morning through Monday morning.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Areas of blowing snow
could significantly reduce visibility.
items.areas: Noatak Valley; Kivalina and Red Dog Dock
items.instruction: Slow down and use caution while traveling.

items.headline: Winter Storm Watch issued October 18 at 6:06AM AKDT until October 21 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Heavy snow possible. Total snow accumulations of 8 to 12
inches possible with higher amounts above pass level. Winds could
gust as high as 40 mph.

* WHERE...Denali Borough.

* WHEN...From Monday afternoon through Wednesday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Following strong southerly winds on Monday,
winds will shift to being out of the north on Tuesday into
Wednesday with gusts up to 40 mph possible.
items.areas: Northern Denali Borough; Southern Denali Borough
items.instruction: Monitor the latest forecasts for updates on this situation.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 18 at 5:42AM AKDT until October 20 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph
expected.

* WHERE...City and Borough of Yakutat.

* WHEN...From 4 PM Monday to 10 PM AKDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds will increase quickly through Monday
evening with the strongest wind gusts expected by early Tuesday
morning.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.
Ensure boats and vessels are secure.

items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp
items.instruction:

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 18 at 4:54AM AKDT until October 20 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations between 4 and 8
inches.

* WHERE...Northern Copper Valley, including the eastern Denali
Highway, Paxson, and Isabel Pass.

* WHEN...From 4 AM Monday to 4 PM AKDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Be prepared for slippery
roads.
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. For the latest road
conditions call 5 1 1 or visit 511.alaska.gov.

items.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued October 17 at 2:08PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
